sources.population: World Bank WDI SP.POP.TOTL (total, mid-year estimate), accessed Oct 2026
sources.fx_rate: World Bank WDI PA.NUS.FCRF (official rate, LCU per USD, annual average), accessed Oct 2026; USA fixed at 1.0

fx_definition: Annual average units of local currency per 1 US dollar (calendar-year basis, Dec 31 year-end convention)
news_note: 2-3 major geopolitical events per year, editorial selection with one-line summaries

geopolitical_news.headline: Three Gorges Dam completed
geopolitical_news.summary: The world's largest dam is finished amid mass resettlement controversies.

geopolitical_news.headline: China-Africa summit in Beijing
geopolitical_news.summary: November summit pledges billions in African investment.

geopolitical_news.headline: Anti-satellite test shocks world
geopolitical_news.summary: January missile destroys a satellite, drawing condemnation over space debris.

geopolitical_news.headline: 17th Party Congress
geopolitical_news.summary: Hu Jintao consolidates power for a second term in October.

geopolitical_news.headline: Sichuan earthquake kills 70,000
geopolitical_news.summary: May quake devastates the southwest; shoddy 'tofu-dreg' schools anger parents.

geopolitical_news.headline: Beijing Olympics
geopolitical_news.summary: August Games showcase China's rise; 51 gold medals top the table.

geopolitical_news.headline: Urumqi riots
geopolitical_news.summary: July ethnic violence in Xinjiang kills nearly 200; a harsh crackdown follows.

geopolitical_news.headline: PRC turns 60
geopolitical_news.summary: October military parade marks the anniversary.

geopolitical_news.headline: Shanghai Expo
geopolitical_news.summary: The $4bn world expo draws a record 73 million visitors.

geopolitical_news.headline: Liu Xiaobo wins Nobel Peace Prize
geopolitical_news.summary: October prize for the jailed dissident enrages Beijing.

geopolitical_news.headline: Beijing-Shanghai rail opens
geopolitical_news.summary: June launch of the flagship high-speed line amid safety concerns.

geopolitical_news.headline: Wenzhou train crash
geopolitical_news.summary: July collision kills 40 and dents faith in the rail boom.

geopolitical_news.headline: Xi Jinping takes power
geopolitical_news.summary: November Party Congress installs Xi; the Bo Xilai scandal purges a rival.

geopolitical_news.headline: Diaoyu/Senkaku tensions flare
geopolitical_news.summary: Japan's island purchase sparks anti-Japan riots across China in September.

geopolitical_news.headline: Third Plenum reform blueprint
geopolitical_news.summary: November meeting promises market reforms and an eased one-child policy.

geopolitical_news.headline: Air defence zone declared
geopolitical_news.summary: November ADIZ over the East China Sea alarms Japan and the US.

geopolitical_news.headline: Hong Kong Umbrella Movement
geopolitical_news.summary: September-December pro-democracy protests paralyze parts of the city.

geopolitical_news.headline: Zhou Yongkang purged
geopolitical_news.summary: The ex-security czar's fall is the anti-corruption drive's biggest catch.

geopolitical_news.headline: Stock market crash
geopolitical_news.summary: Summer meltdown wipes out trillions; the state intervenes heavily.

geopolitical_news.headline: Two-child policy adopted
geopolitical_news.summary: October decision ends the one-child rule.

geopolitical_news.headline: South China Sea ruling rejected
geopolitical_news.summary: July Hague tribunal backs the Philippines; Beijing dismisses it as waste paper.

geopolitical_news.headline: G20 hosted in Hangzhou
geopolitical_news.summary: September summit burnishes Xi's global image.

geopolitical_news.headline: 19th Party Congress
geopolitical_news.summary: October congress enshrines 'Xi Jinping Thought' and upends succession norms.

geopolitical_news.headline: Doklam standoff with India
geopolitical_news.summary: Summer border crisis ends in mutual disengagement.

geopolitical_news.headline: Presidential term limits abolished
geopolitical_news.summary: March constitutional change lets Xi rule indefinitely.

geopolitical_news.headline: Trade war with US begins
geopolitical_news.summary: July US tariffs trigger retaliation and a grinding dispute.

geopolitical_news.headline: Hong Kong protests erupt
geopolitical_news.summary: Mass demonstrations against an extradition bill morph into a broader revolt.

geopolitical_news.headline: Trade war deepens
geopolitical_news.summary: Tariff escalation and the Huawei blacklisting widen the US-China rift.

geopolitical_news.headline: COVID-19 and Wuhan lockdown
geopolitical_news.summary: January lockdown of 11 million people; the virus spreads worldwide.

geopolitical_news.headline: Hong Kong security law
geopolitical_news.summary: June law criminalizes dissent, ending 'one country, two systems' in practice.

geopolitical_news.headline: CCP centenary
geopolitical_news.summary: July celebrations declare a 'moderately prosperous society' achieved.

geopolitical_news.headline: Tech crackdown
geopolitical_news.summary: Ant IPO killed, Didi probed, tutoring banned in a sweeping regulatory storm.

geopolitical_news.headline: Zero-COVID lockdowns
geopolitical_news.summary: Shanghai's two-month spring lockdown sparks anger and shortages.

geopolitical_news.headline: Xi secures third term
geopolitical_news.summary: October Party Congress breaks precedent; rare protests follow in November.

geopolitical_news.headline: Reopening after zero-COVID
geopolitical_news.summary: Abrupt exit fuels a massive infection wave through early 2023.

geopolitical_news.headline: Spy balloon incident
geopolitical_news.summary: February US shootdown of a Chinese balloon freezes a diplomatic thaw.

geopolitical_news.headline: Stimulus to revive economy
geopolitical_news.summary: September package targets the property slump and deflation risks.

geopolitical_news.headline: Military anti-corruption purge
geopolitical_news.summary: Defence ministers fall in an ongoing graft sweep.

geopolitical_news.headline: US tariff war under Trump 2.0
geopolitical_news.summary: Escalating American tariffs meet Chinese retaliation through 2025.

geopolitical_news.headline: WWII anniversary military parade
geopolitical_news.summary: September parade showcases new weaponry amid Taiwan tensions.
